name: the_muse-mcp
description: The Muse (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_the_muse_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_THE_MUSE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_the_muse_api_key.description: Optional: register the app at https://www.themuse.com/developers/api/v2 to get an api_key (sent as the api_key query parameter), raising the limit from 500 to 3,600 requests/hour.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-page jobs request (The Muse has no account endpoint; works without a key at the lower rate limit).

tools.name: search
tools.description: No keyword parameter is documented (filters are category, level, location, company), so query is not sent — filter client-side. page is required and pages hold 20 results (do not pass limit). Rate limit 500 requests/hour without a key, 3,600 with one (X-RateLimit-* headers); the platform answers 403 when exceeded, which surfaces here as auth_error. Content shown must link back to themuse.com.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Same object as a search hit.
